# aws-data-protection

Data-protection posture measured from dumps: KMS rotation on customer-managed keys only, Secrets Manager rotation (metadata, never values), S3 public-access-block and default-encryption posture, and private DNS on interface VPC endpoints.

## Recipes

- `apiforge knowledge show aws-data-protection`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-SEC-107, AF-SEC-108, AF-SEC-109, AF-SEC-110, AF-GW-008
